description: Enforcement-doctrine gate 5 (check half, commit): on `git commit`, if the staged change touches user-visible files (UI/asset/render) and there's no fresh visual proof (a visual-proof-cycle skill invocation this session OR a freshly-modified screenshot file), WARN first, then BLOCK a repeat. Honest escape hatch: SKIP_VISUAL_PROOF=1 + SKIP_VISUAL_PROOF_REASON='why', or an inline `# visual-proof-ok: why`. on_error=open.
